description.narrative:
Stakeholder effects: IFC expects that the Project will support access to short-term finance among MSMEs in Türkiye. MSME suppliers and distributors in emerging markets often lack the ability to set payment terms with larger buyers and distributors, exposing them to longer cash conversion cycles and frequent liquidity pressures. The Project will help address these constraints by working with a leading short-term finance provider to grow its MSME finance portfolio.
Market Creation: IFCs investment under this Project is part of a programmatic effort to support the development of factoring services for MSMEs in Türkiye. By driving investments in the sector, the Project is expected to help diversify funding sources for factoring companies in the market, lowering volatility and enabling growth. This Project would further help focus this growth towards MSME segments, increasing the range and scope of financing products available to MSMEs in Türkiye.

The proposed IFC investment is for extending an up to aggregate US$80 million senior loan to QNB Faktoring A.S. (QNBF or the Company), of which (i) up to US$50 million would be from IFCs own account and, (ii) up to US$30 million is expected to be mobilized under IFCs standard B Loan program on a best effort basis. QNBF is expected to use the IFC investment proceeds for supporting its eligible factoring transactions for micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs). The Project will be processed under IFCs MSME Finance Platform.
